english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 6 and 31(1) of the Tyne and Wear Metro Byelaws made under sections 58 and 62 of the Tyneside Metropolitan Railway Act 1973.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Byelaw 30 make provisions in relation to name and addresses.
(ii) Byelaw 31(2) provides powers for the removal of persons.
(iii) Byelaw 31(3) provides that when using these powers, an authorised person, including a constable, must show his/her identification if requested.
(iv) There are other byelaws which may be more appropriate depending on the circumstances, as well as other normal public order, indecency, damage, harassment and litter offences which may be worth considering.
(v) Byelaw 31(6) provides that an authorised person acting in the course of his duties shall not be liable for breach of Byelaw 6(3).
